_comment: The intended owl:imports of every module in src/, and why. tests/test_module_imports.py compares this file with the real imports: a change to an import is a change to this file, in the same pull request, with its reason. An import can be a dependency the module's own axioms do not show (a data pattern, a property with no domain), so a warning that calls one 'unused' is a question to answer here before anything is deleted (#195).

aec_geometry.aec_provenance: A BoundingBox is an InferredEntity, a CoordinateFrame describes a FilePage, and the file and page are defined there.

aec_drawing_metadata.aec_provenance: Field assertions and inference provenance, the file and page a drawing is on (FilePage), and the agents (Person, Organisation) whose roles the drawing names.
aec_drawing_metadata.aec_geometry: A region of the drawing (a title block, a revision table, a legend, a key plan, a note, a layout) is located with a BoundingBox (geom:hasBoundingBox, which has no domain on purpose), stated as a min 0 restriction on MetadataContainer and on Layout; the box is read in a CoordinateFrame of the page.

aec_common_symbols.aec_drawing_metadata: Symbols are DrawingElements that a Layout contains; they use isComputerVisionLabel and exampleImage, and the reference symbols specialise ReferenceExpression.

aec_domain_common.aec_drawing_metadata: Disciplines and sections classify a Layout; they use isComputerVisionLabel, isComputerVisionOptionalLabel and exampleImage.

aec_facade_domain.aec_drawing_metadata: Facade components are DrawingElements that a Layout contains; they use isComputerVisionLabel and exampleImage.
aec_facade_domain.aec_domain_common: Facade geometry specialises GeometricProperties of the common discipline module.
